Lexie AKA Cuppy (it/she)

Born under mysterious circumstances, involving a plunger and at least two dead gynaecologists, Lexie now roams the land looking for interesting people and cool shit to do.

You can find it in crusty venues bobbing its head to whatever is playing, or in hacker-y, anarchist-y places where it's allowed to be with relatively little trouble.

It makes games and websites primarily, and a bunch of other stuff on the side, often in service of these two pursuits. It might draw, do music, or slam its head against old tech to capture their feel.
